# ref 0.2.0

ref now has three interfaces on one backend: the terminal UI, a new desktop GUI and a new browser UI. A session can be open in several of them at once.

## Before you update

- **The protocol is now version 3** (for the new `question` tool), and 0.1.0 clients are not fully compatible with it. Update `ref` together with `ref-server`, and use the GUI and the web UI of the same release; restart a `ref-server` that you started yourself. A 0.1.0 `ref` on a 0.2.0 backend skips the messages it cannot read: it never shows a question, so the session stays waiting until another window answers it, and its session list stops updating while a session waits for an answer. The GUI and the web UI show a *Restart backend* banner when the backend is older than they are; the terminal UI does not.
- **The archive names have changed**; see Downloads.

## Downloads

Pick an interface: `ref-tui-…` (terminal), `ref-gui-…` (desktop window), `ref-web-…` (browser), or `ref-all-…` (all three). The old `ref-<version>-<platform>` names are gone. Each archive contains the interface, `ref-server`, the READMEs, the license and the docs. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

- The GUI needs, on Linux, glibc 2.38 and the C++ runtime of GCC 13 (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 39, Arch and newer) and X11 or XWayland. It does not start on Ubuntu 22.04 or Debian 12. The terminal UI and the web UI still run on glibc 2.35.
- macOS: the programs are not signed with a developer certificate; run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on them or on `ref.app`.
- Windows: no installer. Unzip and run `ref-gui.exe`.

## Desktop GUI (new)

- A native Qt Quick window (no web view) for Linux, macOS and Windows on x86_64 and arm64. No installation. English and Simplified Chinese; it follows the system language unless you choose one in the settings.
- The conversation streams text and reasoning, renders Markdown with highlighted code blocks, and shows every tool call as a card in all its states (arguments streaming, waiting for permission, delay countdown, running, done, failed, denied, cancelled) with diffs, command output, numbered source lines and pictures. Cards fold and unfold with a click. Allow, allow for the session or deny a tool with a, s and d. Undo takes a prompt back into the input box. Earlier messages load as you scroll up.
- When a session has a to-do list, the status line shows it as the terminal UI does: the item being worked on and *done/total* (cancelled items count in neither), or a green tick when all are done. A click opens the whole list. Every split-view tile has it too.
- A sidebar with the to-do list of the session on screen (*Todo done/total*, hidden while there is none), the running sessions and a searchable history. A command palette (Ctrl+P) and the same `/` commands as the terminal UI, your own commands included. Keyboard shortcuts for the common commands (Ctrl+Shift+letter, Cmd on macOS).
- The input box takes images (paste, drop a file), queues prompts while the session is busy, completes `/commands` and `@files`, supports `!` shell mode, and shares its prompt history with the terminal UI.
- System notifications when a session you are not looking at needs a permission or an answer, finishes a turn or stops with an error; a click opens the session. Where the system cannot show them, the taskbar icon flashes.
- Settings: theme (system, light, dark), language, notifications.
- The same command line as `ref`: `ref-gui [DIR] -c -s -w --agent --model --server --token`.
- Model output is never loaded from the network: Markdown images are shown as links, HTML is shown as text, and links open only for http, https and mailto.

Details: [Desktop GUI](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/gui.md).

## Web UI (new)

- `ref-web` serves the same interface to a browser: run `ref-web` in your project directory and it opens the page. The default address is `http://127.0.0.1:7480`.
- It has the features of the GUI (split view, command palette, shortcuts as Alt+letter, images, queue, the to-do list in the status line and the sidebar, notifications). The settings and the prompt history are stored in the browser.
- It signs in with a token that is kept between runs (`<state dir>/web/login-token`); the address bar does not keep it. The cookie holds a random session id, not the token. Running `ref-web` again opens the browser on the running instance.
- `--host` opens it to the local network, with a warning. There is no TLS there, so use an SSH tunnel or a reverse proxy for anything but a trusted network.
- Browsers show system notifications only on `localhost` and `https` pages; elsewhere the tab title and icon show that something needs attention.

Details: [Web UI](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/web.md).

## Split view and several sessions

- The GUI (Ctrl+Shift+W, `ref-gui -w`) and the web UI (Alt+W) have the split view of the terminal UI: one tile per background session, plus the current one. A click or Alt+arrow keys move the focus, and commands act on the focused tile. A tile can be zoomed (Ctrl+Shift+Z, Alt+Z in the browser). The sidebar selects the session of the focused tile and marks all tiles.
- Only the focused tile shows its input box; the others fold it away and keep the status line and the queue of waiting messages. A draft, attachments and shell mode stay while the box is folded.
- With the split view you can follow a main session that directs worker sessions through the cross-session tools of 0.1.0 (`create_session`, `send_message`, `close_session`). Each worker's tile shows its permission requests and questions. You answer them in that tile: with the mouse in any tile, with the keys in the focused or zoomed one. Messages between sessions are marked with the name of the sending session.

## Questions from the model (new)

- The new `question` tool lets the model ask you one to four questions with options, single or multiple choice, and a typed answer unless the question turns it off. It is opencode's tool, plus one addition: an option can be marked as the default.
- The terminal UI shows a dialog. The GUI shows a card above the session's status line, the web UI inside the card of the tool call; both work with the mouse or the keys (arrows, 1 to 9, Enter, Tab, Esc) and take a typed answer. The session shows "waiting for your answer" in every window and in the session list, and sends a notification like a permission request does. The first answer from any window counts; dismissing the question tells the model, which continues.
- Only the `build` and `plan` agents may ask by default (the `question` permission).

Details: [question](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/tools.md#question), [Questions from the model](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/usage.md#questions-from-the-model).

## Terminal UI

- A question dialog for the `question` tool (see above).
- While a turn runs and the view follows the end of the conversation, the end no longer jumps up when content gets shorter (for example when a retry notice or a tool's live output disappears); the freed space is released when the turn ends. This also applies to the tiles of the split view.

## Backend (`ref-server`)

- One backend for all interfaces. Every interface finds a running backend through the same instance file, or starts the `ref-server` next to it. A backend started that way exits when its last client disconnects, and turns that are still running then stop. A `ref-server` you start yourself keeps running, with its sessions, until you stop it.
- When you switch the agent in a session that already has a conversation, the model is told: a short reminder is added to the conversation without a model turn, so earlier messages written under another agent's instructions do not mislead it. A session with no conversation yet only changes the agent. Several quick switches share one reminder, and switching back removes it. While the session is busy, the reminder is added right before the next request.
- New model option `limit.threshold`: the point where this model's context is compacted automatically, as a fraction of the context window (up to 1) or a number of tokens, like `compaction.threshold`. It overrides the global value for that model, the same way `limit.compact` does for the recommended point. See [Configuration](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/configuration.md).
- Notifications: the backend tells the interface the user is not looking at when a tool needs permission, a question waits for an answer, a turn finishes or a turn ends with an error. Only one interface gets each notification, the one used most recently. Stopping a turn yourself does not send an error notification.
- Sessions remember the error that ended their last turn; interfaces can list directories on the backend machine, which the GUI and web UI use to pick a project directory on a remote backend.
- Requests to providers on loopback addresses (a local Ollama, for example) no longer go through an HTTP proxy.
- A tool that is allowed but waits out its delay no longer shows the session as waiting for permission.
- On Windows, `@` file completions use `/` (they had `\`), and directories are no longer shown with the `\\?\` prefix.
- `ref-server --mock` runs a fake backend with scripted sessions for developing interfaces (see [docs/development.md](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/development.md#the-mock-backend)).

## Other

- A new program logo, used for the GUI's window and app icons, the web UI's favicon, the sidebar header of both, and the README.
- New pages: [Desktop GUI](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/gui.md), [Web UI](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/web.md). The development guide describes the frontend build (Node 24 and pnpm are now needed to build from source), the GUI build and the release process.

## Thanks

- The TUI is modeled on [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode).
- Some tools are modeled on anomalyco/opencode and [can1357/oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi).
- The GUI is adapted from an early version of LightBlueCube/qutie.

---

# ref 0.2.0（简体中文）

ref 现在有三种界面共用一个后端：终端界面、全新的桌面 GUI 和全新的浏览器界面。同一个会话可以同时在多个界面中打开。

## 更新前请注意

- **协议升到第 3 版**（为了新的 `question` 工具），0.1.0 的客户端与它并不完全兼容。请把 `ref` 和 `ref-server` 一起更新，GUI 和 Web 界面也使用同一版本；你自己启动的 `ref-server` 需要重启。0.1.0 的 `ref` 连接 0.2.0 的后端时会跳过它读不懂的消息：它不会显示提问，会话会一直等待，直到别的窗口回答；有会话在等待回答时，它的会话列表也不再更新。后端比 GUI 或 Web 界面旧时，它们会显示带 *重启后端* 按钮的横幅；终端界面不会。
- **压缩包名称已改变**，见“下载”。

## 下载

选择界面：`ref-tui-…`（终端）、`ref-gui-…`（桌面窗口）、`ref-web-…`（浏览器），或 `ref-all-…`（三者都有）。旧的 `ref-<version>-<platform>` 命名不再使用。每个压缩包包含该界面、`ref-server`、两个 README、许可证和文档。请用 `SHA256SUMS` 校验下载内容。

- Linux 上的 GUI 需要 glibc 2.38 和 GCC 13 的 C++ 运行库（Ubuntu 24.04、Debian 13、Fedora 39、Arch 及更新版本），以及 X11 或 XWayland；在 Ubuntu 22.04 和 Debian 12 上无法启动。终端界面和 Web 界面仍然只需要 glibc 2.35。
- macOS：程序没有用开发者证书签名；请对它们或 `ref.app` 运行 `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine`。
- Windows：没有安装程序，解压后运行 `ref-gui.exe`。

## 桌面 GUI（新）

- 原生 Qt Quick 窗口（不是网页视图），支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 的 x86_64 与 arm64。无需安装。界面有英文和简体中文，默认跟随系统语言，也可以在设置里选择。
- 对话视图：流式输出文本和推理，渲染 Markdown 和带语法高亮的代码块，每个工具调用是一张卡片，显示所有状态（参数流式生成、等待授权、延迟倒计时、运行中、完成、出错、被拒绝、已取消），并展示 diff、命令输出、带行号的源码和图片。点击卡片可以展开或折叠。用 a、s、d 允许、本会话内允许或拒绝工具。撤销会把提示放回输入框。向上滚动时自动加载更早的消息。
- 会话有待办清单时，状态行像终端界面一样显示它：正在进行的事项和*完成数/总数*（已取消的事项不计入），全部完成时显示绿色的勾。点击会打开完整清单。分屏视图的每个分块也有。
- 侧边栏显示当前会话的待办清单（*Todo 完成数/总数*，没有清单时隐藏）、运行中的会话和可搜索的历史。命令面板（Ctrl+P）和与终端界面相同的 `/` 命令，包括你自己的命令。常用命令有快捷键（Ctrl+Shift+字母，macOS 上是 Cmd）。
- 输入框支持图片（粘贴、拖放文件）、会话忙时排队、`/命令` 和 `@文件` 补全、`!` shell 模式，并与终端界面共用提示历史。
- 当你没有在看的会话需要授权或回答、结束一轮或以错误结束时，显示系统通知，点击通知会打开该会话。系统无法显示通知时，任务栏图标会闪烁。
- 设置：主题（跟随系统、浅色、深色）、语言、通知。
- 命令行与 `ref` 一致：`ref-gui [DIR] -c -s -w --agent --model --server --token`。
- 模型输出的内容不会触发网络请求：Markdown 里的图片显示为链接，HTML 按文字显示，链接只对 http、https 和 mailto 打开。

详见[桌面 GUI](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/gui.zh-CN.md)。

## Web 界面（新）

- `ref-web` 把同样的界面提供给浏览器：在项目目录运行 `ref-web`，它会打开页面。默认地址是 `http://127.0.0.1:7480`。
- 功能与 GUI 相同（分屏视图、命令面板、Alt+字母快捷键、图片、排队、状态行和侧边栏里的待办清单、通知）。设置和提示历史保存在浏览器里。
- 用一个跨重启保留的 token 登录（`<state 目录>/web/login-token`），地址栏中不会保留 token。cookie 里是随机会话 id，不是 token。再次运行 `ref-web` 会直接在浏览器中打开已运行的实例。
- `--host` 向局域网开放，并打印警告。该模式没有 TLS，除可信网络外请使用 SSH 隧道或反向代理。
- 浏览器只在 `localhost` 和 `https` 页面显示系统通知；其他地址只有标签页标题和图标提示需要处理。

详见 [Web 界面](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/web.zh-CN.md)。

## 分屏视图与多会话

- GUI（Ctrl+Shift+W、`ref-gui -w`）和 Web 界面（Alt+W）有和终端界面一样的分屏视图：每个后台会话一个分块，再加上当前会话。点击或 Alt+方向键移动焦点，命令作用于有焦点的分块。分块可以放大（Ctrl+Shift+Z，浏览器里是 Alt+Z）。侧边栏选中有焦点分块的会话，并标出所有分块。
- 只有有焦点的分块显示输入框；其他分块把它折叠起来，保留状态行和排队的消息。输入框折叠时，草稿、附件和 shell 模式都会保留。
- 用分屏视图可以跟踪一个主会话通过 0.1.0 已有的跨会话工具（`create_session`、`send_message`、`close_session`）指挥多个工作会话。每个工作会话的分块显示它的授权请求和提问，你在该分块里回答：任何分块都可以用鼠标，按键只作用于有焦点或放大的分块。会话之间的消息会标出发送方会话的名称。

## 模型的提问（新）

- 新的 `question` 工具让模型向你提出一到四个带选项的问题，单选或多选；除非问题关闭了这一项，你也可以自己输入回答。它就是 opencode 的同名工具，另加一项：选项可以标为默认。
- 终端界面显示对话框。GUI 在会话的状态行上方显示一张卡片，Web 界面显示在该工具调用的卡片里；两者都可以用鼠标或按键（方向键、1 到 9、Enter、Tab、Esc）回答，也可以输入自己的回答。会话在所有窗口和会话列表里显示“等待你的回答”，并像授权请求一样发出通知。任何一个窗口的第一个回答生效；驳回问题时模型会收到通知并继续。
- 默认只有 `build` 和 `plan` 智能体可以提问（`question` 权限）。

详见 [question](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/tools.zh-CN.md#question)、[模型的提问](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/usage.zh-CN.md#模型的提问)。

## 终端界面

- 为 `question` 工具新增提问对话框（见上文）。
- 一轮进行中且视图跟随对话底部时，内容变短（例如重试提示或工具的实时输出消失）不再让底部上移；空出的空间在这一轮结束时一次性收回。分屏视图的每个分块也是如此。

## 后端（`ref-server`）

- 所有界面共用一个后端。每个界面通过同一个 instance 文件找到运行中的后端，没有时启动同目录的 `ref-server`。这样启动的后端在最后一个客户端断开后退出，仍在进行的回合随之停止。你自己启动的 `ref-server` 会一直运行并保留会话，直到你停止它。
- 在已有对话的会话中切换智能体时会通知模型：对话里加入一条简短的提醒（不触发模型回合），这样此前在另一个智能体指令下写成的消息不会误导它。还没有对话的会话只改变智能体。连续快速切换共用一条提醒，切回原来的智能体会删除它。会话忙时，提醒在下一次请求之前加入。
- 新的模型选项 `limit.threshold`：该模型自动压缩上下文的位置，取值与 `compaction.threshold` 相同，可以是上下文窗口的比例（不超过 1）或 token 数。它覆盖该模型的全局值，就像 `limit.compact` 覆盖建议压缩点一样。见[配置](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/configuration.zh-CN.md)。
- 通知：当工具需要授权、提问等待回答、一轮结束或一轮以错误结束时，后端通知用户没有在看的那个界面。每条通知只发给一个界面，即最近使用的那个。你自己停止的一轮不会发出错误通知。
- 会话记住上一轮结束时的错误；界面可以列出后端所在机器上的目录，GUI 和 Web 界面用它在远程后端上选择项目目录。
- 发往本机回环地址上的模型服务（例如本地的 Ollama）的请求不再经过 HTTP 代理。
- 已获允许、正在等待延迟的工具不再让会话显示为等待授权。
- Windows 上的 `@` 文件补全改用 `/`（之前是 `\`），目录也不再显示 `\\?\` 前缀。
- `ref-server --mock` 提供带预设脚本的假后端，用于开发界面（见 [docs/development.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/development.zh-CN.md#mock-后端)）。

## 其他

- 新的程序标志，用于 GUI 的窗口和应用图标、Web 界面的网站图标、两者的侧边栏顶部和 README。
- 新增页面：[桌面 GUI](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/gui.zh-CN.md)、[Web 界面](https://github.com/GDNDZZK/ref/blob/v0.2.0/docs/web.zh-CN.md)。开发文档说明了前端构建（从源码构建现在需要 Node 24 和 pnpm）、GUI 构建和发布流程。

## 致谢

- TUI 参考了 [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode)。
- 部分工具参考了 anomalyco/opencode 和 [can1357/oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)。
- GUI 改编自 LightBlueCube/qutie 的早期版本。
